name: The St. Regis Singapore
short_description: A St. Regis hotel on Tanglin Road, at the edge of Orchard Road and a short walk from the Botanic Gardens.
ai_summary: The St. Regis Singapore stands on Tanglin Road where the Orchard Road shopping belt meets the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the embassy district. Guest reviews consistently praise the signature butler service for small, practical touches -- fresh coffee or tea delivered on request, complimentary daily pressing of two items -- alongside spotless rooms and meticulous housekeeping. It's one of two Bonvoy top-luxury properties in this directory's Singapore list, alongside The Ritz-Carlton, Millenia Singapore, but sits in the Orchard/Tanglin part of the city rather than Marina Bay. The most consistent criticism in reviews is that butler service, while pleasant, doesn't always feel as anticipatory or bespoke as the St. Regis brand promise implies -- several guests describe it as closer to attentive room service than a truly personalized concierge relationship, and a few feel the experience doesn't fully justify the price premium.

faqs.question: What does butler service actually include at The St. Regis Singapore?
faqs.answer: Guests report concrete perks like on-request coffee or tea delivery and complimentary daily pressing of two clothing items. Some reviews note it feels closer to attentive room service than a fully anticipatory, personalized concierge relationship, so set expectations accordingly.

faqs.question: Is The St. Regis Singapore close to the Botanic Gardens?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's a short walk from the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, at the quieter end of Orchard Road near the city's embassy district.
